tools.name: search_products
tools.description: Search public sellable variants by words, brand/category/purpose, skin type, ingredient, availability and price in SGD cents. Use variant_id when adding items; follow next_page for more results.

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: Get product descriptions, ingredients, usage, images and variants. product accepts a product ID, product slug, variant slug or SKU.

tools.name: create_cart
tools.description: Create an empty persistent cart owned by this agent credential. Save cart_id and version.

tools.name: get_cart
tools.description: Read cart items, coupon, version and checkout lock.

tools.name: set_cart_item
tools.description: Add or update a variant using an absolute quantity; zero removes it. Supply the current cart version. Maximum 20 variants and 99 units each; availability is checked.

tools.name: set_cart_coupon
tools.description: Apply a coupon code or null to remove it. Supply current cart version. Auto discounts also apply.

tools.name: quote_cart
tools.description: Reprice the cart with current stock, scheduled prices and discounts. All amounts are SGD cents; shipping is free within Singapore. Stock is not reserved. Save version and total for checkout.

tools.name: create_checkout
tools.description: Prepare a Tanatasa checkout review link for a quoted cart. Provide quoted version and expected_total in SGD cents. Keep the same idempotency_key and input on retries. Locks cart. Buyer reviews items and enters contact/delivery details on Tanatasa before paying. No payment occurs in this tool; get_or

tools.name: get_order
tools.description: Get payment and fulfilment status and tracking for an order created by this credential. Payment confirmation comes from Stripe webhooks.

tools.name: checkout_session
tools.description: Prepare checkout from product feed item IDs and quantities. Optional item metadata is not authoritative. Returns a Tanatasa review link; the buyer enters delivery details and approves payment. Supply a new idempotency_key per purchase and retain it on retries.
